news.title: CSE student named 18th Block Captain for University of Minnesota Marching Band
news.summary_en: College of Science and Engineering (CSE) student Brennen Lishman was named the 18th Block Captain of the University of Minnesota Marching Band earlier this year.

news.title: Zooniverse, co-founded by University of Minnesota professor, reaches one billion volunteer classifications
news.summary_en: Zooniverse's billionth classification milestone highlights the University of Minnesota College of Science & Engineering's commitment to developing innovative approaches that accelerate scientific discovery. Image courtesy of Snapshot Serengeti.
